_comment: Look library v3 (docs/LIBRARY_V1.md, section "Library v3"): library v2 + 12 classic colour looks (recipes sim/recipes/library_v3.json). 32 looks: the LOOKS.BIN form for the 32-look loader (v2 order kept, new looks after the colour looks, mono last). Atrophy (inspired by GxAce) replaced Provia (= stock profile at zero). Cuban Neg (inspired by Osan's Classic Cuban Neg) replaced Superia 400 (redundant with Classic Neg). Provia 400 (Provia 400X) replaced Nostalgic. Halation (0.31h2, docs/HALATION_RED.md §17): a bloom with a tint is a halo; strength 1-2 Low, 3-4 Med, 5 High. CineStill800 Med red, CineStill50D / Vision3 500T Low red, Portra 400 / Polaroid Low warm, Gold 200 Low amber.

velvia.name: Velvia
velvia.notes: Saturated landscape slide film: deep skies, dense greens, crushed shadows.

astia.name: Astia
astia.notes: Soft slide film: gentle contrast, clean skin, slightly richer skies.

cl_chrome.name: Cl. Chrome
cl_chrome.notes: Documentary look: muted greens and yellows, cyan skies, hard shadows.

cl_neg.name: Classic Neg
cl_neg.notes: Superia-style negative: teal-green cast, punchy mids, light skies.

provia400.name: Provia 400
provia400.notes: Fujichrome Provia 400X slide: magenta-red cast, lavender skies, rich blues, deep reds, dark greens, fast fall to black, fine grain. Advice: contrast +1.

reala.name: Reala Ace
reala.notes: Accurate, crisp modern negative: true hues, restrained greens.

eterna.name: Eterna
eterna.notes: Cinema negative: flat, open shadows, quiet teal-leaning colour.

bleach.name: Bleach Byp.
bleach.notes: Silver-retained cinema look: near-monochrome, harsh contrast.

kchrome.name: Kodachrome64
kchrome.notes: Rich deep reds, golden yellows, dense cyan-blue skies, olive greens.

portra.name: Portra 400
portra.notes: Warm pastel portrait negative: glowing skin, soft contrast.

ektar.name: Ektar 100
ektar.notes: Ultra-vivid fine-grain negative: saturated reds and blues.

gold.name: Gold 200
gold.notes: Golden consumer negative: sunny yellows, muted cyan skies.

ektachrome.name: Ektachrome
ektachrome.notes: Clean, cool slide film: neutral skin, bright saturated blues.

cinestill.name: CineStill800
cinestill.notes: Tungsten cinema film: cool cast, red bloom (bloom + bloom_tint red: the glow's Cr spreads far more than its luma, docs/HALATION_RED.md section 8) plus red/orange light.

pro400h.name: Pro 400H
pro400h.notes: Airy pastel negative: minty greens, light cyan skies.

aerochrome.name: Faux IR
aerochrome.notes: Infrared-inspired false colour (golden/orange foliage, deep blue skies). Not true Aerochrome: the hue range can't turn green red. Sat advice: strong (+3..+5).

kchrome25.name: Kodachrome25
kchrome25.notes: Kodachrome 25 slide (GarethB, mu-43): dense, rich reds, muted cyan/green, deep shadows. Advice: contrast +2, H-2 M+3 S-5.

portra160.name: Portra 160
portra160.notes: Fine-grain portrait negative (I. Mitropoulos, om-recipes): natural skin, quiet greens, soft contrast.

fuji200.name: Fujicolor200
fuji200.notes: Fujicolor C200 (J. Bloomer, om-recipes): warm yellows, fresh greens, soft contrast.

cuban.name: Cuban Neg
cuban.notes: Inspired by Osan's Classic Cuban Neg: warm Classic Neg, golden cast (WB A+4), deep blues/reds, gritty grain, bloom 3. Sat: +2 warm, -2 greens.

cibachrome.name: Cibachrome
cibachrome.notes: Cibachrome print (Jay, om-recipes): glossy magenta-reds, deep blues, rich darks.

ultramax.name: UltraMax 400
ultramax.notes: Kodak consumer negative: warm, punchy reds/yellows, olive greens, visible grain.

agfa.name: Agfa Vista
agfa.notes: Agfa Vista 200: vivid magenta-leaning reds, deep blues, cool cheap-film punch.

cs50d.name: CineStill50D
cs50d.notes: Daylight cinema stock: clean, slightly cool, rich blues, soft highlights, faint red glow.

v250d.name: Vision3 250D
v250d.notes: Kodak daylight cinema negative: flat, wide latitude, gentle teal/orange separation.

v500t.name: Vision3 500T
v500t.notes: Tungsten cinema negative in daylight: cool teal cast, warm lights, open shadows.

polaroid.name: Polaroid
polaroid.notes: Integral instant film: punchy, narrow dynamic range (bright highlights, deep shadows), warm highlights, cyan-green shadows.

xpro.name: Cross Proc.
xpro.notes: E-6 slide in C-41: hard contrast, yellow-green highlights, cyan skies, yellowed skin.

atrophy.name: Atrophy
atrophy.notes: Inspired by GxAce's Atrophy: urban-decay grade, near-grey base, muted greens/skies, rust and reds kept, gritty clarity. Sat advice: greens/blues -4..-5.

acros.name: Acros
acros.notes: Fine-grain mono: deep blacks, smooth tones, darker reds.

trix.name: Tri-X 400
trix.notes: Classic gritty reportage mono: punchy contrast, darker skies.

hp5.name: HP5 Plus
hp5.notes: Soft, grainy mono with wide latitude and open shadows.
